title: Wonderful Voxels
description: A Minecraft modpack that adds amazing shaders, redesigned sound physics, and overhauled terrain generation for a beautiful Minecraft experience.
body: This modpack adds shaders, extra terrain generation, and better sound physics to your game to enhance the Minecraft experience. All mods compatible with Fabric 1.21.11 can be added to the modpack. The modpack also includes a zoom feature (incorporating WI Zoom) to enable you to zoom in to your gameplay. Great for content creators and casual players!
